metadata.genoa:note: Simple, dependency-light basemap: a dark raster (no pmtiles protocol, no /basemap proxy, no glyphs/sprite). Renders immediately. The self-hosted Studio Midnight vector style (protomaps-themes-base, scripts/build-map-style.mjs) is the later upgrade once the live vector path is proven. RF data layers (stations/contours) are added on top in code from the map LAYERS registry.
